## Why agentic CMS is a yesWhy agentic CMS is a yesWhy agentic CMS is a yesWhy agentic CMS is a yesWhy agentic CMS is a yes

![Lightbulb illustration](https://images1.cmp.optimizely.com/Zz0zM2ZhOWE0YTU2MGQxMWYxYmE2MjY2Y2U5ZDdhYzhlNA==)

### Knows your business

Optimizely's CMS already knows your brand, audience, and workflows. Unlike layered-on AI tools, agents have context from day one.

![illustration](https://images2.cmp.optimizely.com/Zz0zNDBkODY1YTU2MGQxMWYxOTViZGNlYzg1MDFmMDg2NQ==)

### Grounded in your content

Every output pulls from your content library. Pages, assets, data, you name it. Whatever gets created is accurate and ready to publish.

![Plug-in illustration](https://images1.cmp.optimizely.com/Zz0zNDA1ZTMxZTU2MGQxMWYxYTk4MjY2Y2U5ZDdhYzhlNA==)

### Connects your tools

Connect to applications like Salesforce, Figma, or Marketo so agents can pull in data, trigger updates, and keep work moving automatically.

![Done illustration](https://images1.cmp.optimizely.com/Zz0zM2Y1NGVlNjU2MGQxMWYxOGMyN2IyZTdhN2E0YTZiMA==)

### Works without prompting

Agents trigger actions based on events or schedules, so workflows move forward on their own with approvals built in.
